name: Kotohira (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kotohira town emblem in green: a stylised swirl of angular strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kotohira, a town in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 December 1972.

features.role: Kotohira town emblem — a stylised swirl of angular strokes, like a stylised character
